scope: Exact seven original interfaces only; acceptance of their disclosed conditional/derived meaning before port, not a source Anchor equivalence or a fresh kernel check.

source_deltas.delta: Finite Euclidean source generalized to an arbitrary complete real inner-product space. Completeness is inherited by reused APIs; no finite-dimensionality premise.

psi:X->R becomes a total ambient real function with differentiability on int X. The ordered formula agrees with source divergence on X x int X under an actual source representative. Existing divergence_extension_eq handles interior-base independence, but the full source representation wrapper is not supplied here. Sharp helpers additionally omit V subset X and generator convexity.

Source losses have no bottom value and are finite on nonempty V; that supplies properness mathematically. Lean explicitly asks SourceProper and global ambient supports on V, and proves finiteness/convexity of the finite part there. A source-carrier transport wrapper is not one of these five theorems.

The bounds condition on success through T of the exact classical-choice Option recursion and interiority of every reached state. This is not arbitrary minimizer-sequence coverage, universal existence, executable optimization, or interior preservation. Closedness of V and psi is omitted as unused in the conditional proof. u in V entails V nonempty.

Source loss round t+1 maps to Lean loss t; source decision x_(t+1) remains Lean x(t+1); last source step eta_T maps to eta(T-1). Lean monotonicity is on played pairs t+1<T, whereas the literal source wording also mentions the unprovided eta_(T+1). This is a disclosed range normalization/generalization, not a repaired source statement.

Shared/fixed interfaces admit T=0. Shared and fixed-sharp reduce to 0<=0; fixed-regret gives 0<=B(u;x0)/eta. Variable interfaces require T>0. The zero-horizon extension is derived library scope, not printed Theorem15.30.

The implementation uses finite-part convexity, a feasible-segment comparison differentiating only the smooth penalty, Bregman algebra and telescoping. It bypasses the unjustified smooth-Theorem2.8 selected-subgradient step. It does not prove that selected-subgradient assertion, close G-optimality, or approve a source repair. The fixed-step exercise has a library derivation under the conditional interface only.
